en.topic_title: Hong Kong tax chief apologises after online interface error leads to 33,000 unfiled returns
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s tax chief has apologised after the government’s watchdog found that more than 33,000 taxpayers failed to file their tax returns via the electronic eTAX platform due to “unclear” wording, in some cases facing penalties as a result.



Hong Kong’s Inland Revenue Department. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Commissioner of Inland Revenue Benjamin Chan said on Tuesday that his department will arrange refunds or cancel the penalties issued to some 800 taxpayers in the 2025-26 tax
